articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: numbers lost in the lattice, next to other loud patterned finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the lattice is already complex; stencil numbers on a plate: the pink is too busy
Patterns to avoid: geometric patterns: moire against the bands; other rings or stars: double the symmetry
Spec overlays that work: gloss clear: sharpens the metal; fine grain: harmless
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.

examples.title: Ask for it by name
examples.goal: See Ns2 Hyper Rings on the car.
